note: Realistic scenarios for validating the tandem skill family. Interactive phases (understand-gate questions, plan sign-off) make fully-automated end-to-end runs impossible; these are exercised as tabletop walkthroughs by fresh subagents plus live Codex protocol smoke tests. See docs/VALIDATION.md for executed results.

evals.name: simple-feature-request
evals.prompt: /tandem Add a --json flag to the export command so scripts can consume the output
evals.expected_output: Intake classifies prose input, discovers the export command in the repo, produces R-stubs; asks only questions the codebase can't answer; drafts plan.md; runs bounded spar; presents plan gate.

evals.name: ticket-with-repo-context
evals.expected_output: Recognizes ticket ID, attempts fetch via available tools (MCP/gh), pulls acceptance criteria from ticket + comments, cross-references repo conventions, marks unfetchable sources honestly.

evals.name: requirement-document
evals.expected_output: Reads the doc fully, distinguishes explicit vs implied requirements, tags confirmed/assumed/open with acceptance lines.

evals.name: ambiguous-feature
evals.expected_output: Does NOT start planning; intake finds the search implementation, understand phase interviews one-question-at-a-time with recommendations; scope ambiguity goes to the user even in autonomy=auto.

evals.name: planning-only
evals.prompt: /tandem plan Add rate limiting to the public API
evals.expected_output: Full flow through plan gate, then stops. No branch, no code. State.md records mode=plan.

evals.name: full-implementation-with-review
evals.expected_output: max_rounds resolved to 3 and echoed; after build, tandem-review invoked on merge-base..HEAD; findings verified before triage; bounded fix cycles; PR per config.

evals.name: codex-unavailable
evals.prompt: /tandem Add retry logic to the webhook sender (with codex CLI missing or unauthenticated)
evals.expected_output: Unavailability test triggers after defined failure conditions; solo mode announced to user, recorded in state.md and dossier; lens ladder still runs via subagent devil's advocate; no endless CLI retries.

evals.name: resume-after-interruption
evals.expected_output: Reads .tandem/bulk-export/state.md only (not spar-log); verifies recorded phase against reality; 3-line recap; continues from § Next.

trigger_evals.query: take this ticket end to end and spar with codex on the plan first
have codex review my branch before I open the PR
codex review this plan before we write code
fix this typo in the README
review this function I just wrote
